name: Stovec Industries Limited
about: Stovec Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of textile machinery and consumables in India and internationally. The company operates through Textile Consumables and Textile Machinery, and Graphics Product segments. The Textile Consumables and Textile Machinery segment offers perforated rotary screens, lacquer and auxiliary chemicals, rotary screen-printing machines, perforated nickel screens, engraving equipment, components, and spares, as well as digital inks. The Graphics Product segment provides anilox rollers, rotamesh screens, and rotaplate products. It also provides digital printing machines. The company also exports its products. It serves processing companies and mills in the textile and graphics printing sector. Stovec Industries Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Ahmedabad, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of SPGPrints B.V.
